 The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.4100 of 2024

entities.text: Boinapally Ravinder Rao vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner, who is arrayed as accused No.7, seeking to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.599 of 2023 on the file of Subedari Police Station, Warangal District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 420, 506 read with 34 of IPC and Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard Sri A. Prabhakar Rao, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri S. Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.

3. Without going into the merits of the case, since the punishment prescribed for the offences alleged against the petitioner is less than seven (07) years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioner to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 29.04.2024 between 11:00 a.m.
and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner shall submit his defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
Further, if the petitioner is not cooperating with the investigation, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to take action in accordance with the law.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.

Note:
